item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone resilience for Azure VMs
item.description:
Zone resilience for Azure VMs is in public preview. It allows an eligible zonal VM to be recovered in another availability zone within the same region while keeping the existing VM resource and configuration, with ZRS managed disks used for synchronous cross-zone replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Item Level Recovery for Azure VMs with Premium SSDv2 and Ultra Disks in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports item-level recovery for Azure VMs using Premium SSD v2 and Ultra disks, including both 512-byte and 4KB logical sector sizes. This lets you recover individual files and folders from these VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Per-disk resiliency for Azure VMs
item.description:
Azure VMs now have a public preview option for per-disk resiliency. By default, Azure still recovers a VM by shutting it down and powering it back on after managed disk connectivity is restored.

  • Source: Azure Updates
